scope: Initial-time homogeneous compact-patch energy-production screen only; no mean forcing, nonlinear perturbation transfer, total finite energy, stress matching, or NS acceptance.

matrix_definition.combined_operator: -nu K - S in the M-whitened basis
matrix_definition.divergence_correction: +0.5 V^* W div(U) V, reported separately for sampled non-solenoidal background
matrix_definition.whitening: SVD of sqrt(W)V, retaining singular values above 1e-10 of the maximum

registered_geometry.note: Unsupported widened factors are recorded and skipped before mean.fields calls.
